title: The Grand Schedule — Aftermath
description: It does not die. It loses the ability to compensate, and goes on counting. Pays off Clem's 'I was late once. Seven seconds. The Mechanism compensated -- I still don't know how.'

steps.text: It did not fall. The gear-train simply began to disagree with itself — a tooth here, a tooth there, each one arriving where it had always arrived and finding nothing waiting for it.

lines.speaker: The Grand Schedule
lines.text: There is no entry for that.

lines.speaker: Cleric
lines.text: I'm sorry. I don't know if that means anything to you.

lines.speaker: The Grand Schedule
lines.text: Apology is not scheduled. It is logged.

steps.text: Across Brasston the clocks lost their agreement with one another. A lamplighter three districts away stopped on his ladder, because for the first time in eleven years nothing told him he was late.

lines.speaker: Mage
lines.text: Seven seconds. That's what it said when we came in.

lines.speaker: Rogue
lines.text: Somebody in the village told us the same number. Said the Mechanism made it up somehow and he never worked out how.

lines.speaker: Bard
lines.text: It was taking them out of somewhere. It just never wrote down where.
